title: Who paid off the Oliver band
summary: Asked who paid the band, Barnes says Oliver never did; Clarence Black, the director, handled it.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Who used to pay off in the band? Did you all ever pay off the fellows? No. Just one second. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
The second track of Paul Vaughn, Reel 1, June 16, 1969. We're talking about paying off, huh, Baron? Oh, yeah. Yeah, I was asking you, who used to pay off the band to do it with Joe Oliver?

Joe Oliver never pays off himself. He always had someone who wanted to take that. Now, Clarence Black, when I first went out there, Clarence Black is the director. And he would do the paying off. He tend to have been.
